identity.about: Senior Integration Specialist with 10+ years of experience in enterprise integration, middleware engineering, Linux infrastructure, cloud platforms, automation, and digital transformation within aviation and enterprise IT environments. Experienced in Azure Integration Services (AIS), enterprise middleware, APIs, reverse proxy technologies, enterprise automation, production support, and high-availability systems. Strong background in enterprise architecture, operational support, workflow automation, infrastructure optimization, incident troubleshooting, release management, and enterprise modernization initiatives. Proven ability to support mission-critical enterprise systems, optimize operational workflows, and deliver scalable enterprise IT integration solutions.

branding.tagline: I build and run the integrations that connect aviation systems to the enterprise.
branding.elevator_pitch: I design and deliver secure, scalable enterprise integrations that connect critical systems, automate business processes, and improve operational reliability.

experience.description: Lead enterprise integration and digital transformation initiatives supporting aviation operational systems, including AMOS interfacing and backend system integrations. Architect and manage enterprise integrations between core business systems, middleware platforms, Azure services, APIs, and third-party applications. Develop scalable automation workflows using Azure Integration Services (AIS), Power Automate, APIs, and SFTP integrations. Manage enterprise middleware operations, production deployment, UAT coordination, release validation, and operational readiness. Support high-availability enterprise environments and mission-critical production systems, applying DevOps principles. Develop operational dashboards, enterprise monitoring solutions, automated notifications, and reporting enhancements. Implement enterprise-grade integration security standards for APIs, SFTP workflows, and data exchange. Support cloud integration initiatives across development, testing, and production environments. Participate in CAB meetings, deployment planning, and enterprise release coordination. Build automated reporting solutions improving operational visibility and management reporting.
